# Signatories

## Project team
**Eduardo Gonzalo Moyano Baquero, M.A.E.**
**Principal Investigator and Lead Developer**

Statistical and Computer Engineer. Responsible for methodological design, R package architecture, R/Shiny implementation, Discriminant Analysis workflow integration, and statistical verification. While his software engineering experience stems primarily from enterprise and private sector developments, his technical capability in R/Shiny is directly demonstrated through the functional interactive MVP.
**Live Interactive Prototype (MVP): https://bds-eduardo-baquero.shinyapps.io/SOFTWARE-DISCRIMINANTE/**

**Lilia Beatriz Santos Díaz, M.A.E., M.S.I.G., M.I.A.**
**UX/UI and Front-End Specialist**

Computer Systems Engineer with extensive background in enterprise software development. Responsible for user experience design, interface optimization with `bslib`, front-end interaction testing, and usability evaluation.

**Ma. Mercedes Jaramillo Campos, M.A.E.**
**QA, Process, and Documentation Specialist**

Computer Systems Engineer specialized in process engineering and quality assurance. Responsible for test planning, execution, automated test design (`testthat`, `shinytest2`), bug tracking, and user documentation for the R package.

**Note on Track Record:** The project team’s professional trajectory has been built primarily within the private corporate sector. Consequently, proprietary enterprise codebases cannot be published. Public technical verification of the team's execution capabilities is provided via the live interactive Shiny MVP linked above.
